frontmatter.name: notes-to-llms
frontmatter.description: Convert local note folders, Obsidian vaults and exports through a reproducible normalizer, source mirror, anchored units and llms lint gate. TRIGGER: "/n2l", "normalize this vault into an llms family", "build source-anchored llms files from this local notes folder", "make this notes export pass llms_lint". SKIP: lightweight mixed-note drafting without the normalizer/linter pipeline → notes-to-llms-txt; preserve notes as notes → note-organizer; existing llms-family audit or graded topical pool → llms-deep-optimizer; format spec → document-formats; one-document inventory → llms-txt-tooling (references/document- distiller.md); live site mirroring → web-text-mirror.
whenToUse: normalize this local notes folder into source-anchored llms files
convert this Obsidian export with the normalizer and lint gate
run /n2l on this vault and account for rejected units
